verdict.rationale: Poly's documented versioning, Flashback review, and rollback cover files and folders, including undoing an agent's edits to a file. There is no evidence of automation definitions as artifacts that can themselves be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. File-level history is an adjacent feature that recovers what an automation changed, not version control for the automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
